# Krea

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 4 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: dark generative-media app design: a Tailwind v4 token layer (primary grey ramp, #006eff action blue, Suisse Intl) painted only as html.dark, a 255px sidebar shell with a white Sign in pill, a prompt composer, and a marketing pricing page with white plan pills.

Captured 2026-11-18, read-only (the home shell, pricing, enterprise, blog, plugins, MCP, the image tool, docs, terms and the login card are public; a Continue with Email attempt on 2026-11-18 was stopped by Cloudflare Turnstile: GET /api/auth/email-flow returned 400 captcha_failed with no visible widget, so assets, train, nodes, account, billing, API keys, checkout and generation remain behind sign-in; Sign in, Sign up, OAuth, Book a call, Get Pro and Generate were measured, never followed except that one Email continue; the prompt and email fields were filled; consent overlays were hidden, never answered). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Krea's public signed-out website, for building a dark generative-media app shell, a pricing page and a login card in the style of the real thing. It was read from **www.krea.ai** on **2026-11-18**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Captured: the home app shell, /pricing, /enterprise, /blog, /plugins, /mcp, /features/ai-image-generator, /login, /image, /docs, /terms and a 404 at /about, plus 390px passes on the home, pricing and login.

Krea paints one public theme, `html.dark`. The Tailwind v4 `@theme` layer on `:root,:host` declares a primary grey ramp (`--color-primary-0` through `--color-primary-1000`, including 150, 250, 850 and 975), action colours (`--color-action` `#006eff`, hover `#0064fe`, green `#65f223`, purple `#af00ff`), radius steps, a 4px spacing base, and Suisse Intl. Semantic roles (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--sidebar`, `--destructive`, `--warning`, `--success`) live on `.dark`. The body field is `--color-primary-950` `#101010`. Those painted roles are stored in the light token set, because this library's catalog reads a light semantic set. The dark set is empty. There is no public light switch. Docs uses a separate sheet set and is not folded into the app tokens.

**Boundary:** everything past login (assets, train, node editor, account, billing, API keys, checkout and generation) was never reached. Sign in, Sign up, Continue with Google, Apple and SSO, Book a call, Get Free, Get Basic, Get Pro, Get Max, Claim offer and Generate were measured, never followed. Continue with Email was submitted once on 2026-11-18; GET /api/auth/email-flow returned 400 captcha_failed (Cloudflare Turnstile, no visible widget) and the pass stopped. The prompt field was filled and cleared. Consent overlays were hidden, never answered.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **The light set is the painted dark theme.** Catalog swatches named `light.*` are what `html.dark` paints. Do not treat them as a light product theme.
- **`--background` and the body field differ.** `--background` resolves to `#0a0a0a`. The body uses `dark:bg-primary-950`, which is `#101010`. The page you see is `#101010`.
- **Some computed colours stay in oklch.** Sign in's fill was read as `oklch(0.985 0 0)`, which is the near-white `--primary` role. The stylesheet harvest stores the same role as `#fafafa`. Prefer the harvest hex when a component token still says oklch.
- **Marketing heroes can be light while html is dark.** /plugins and /features paint a white hero. That is a marketing surface, not a second theme.
- **A few selectors missed their node.** `price-card`, `faq-item`, `composer-send`, `image-generate`, `m-sidebar` and `m-signin` are recorded as missing. Get Pro, the composer field, Sign in and the phone menu were measured.
- **Quantised screenshots band gradients.** Read exact colours from tokens.json or the raw JSON.
- **The offer strip is a campaign.** The copy captured on 2026-11-18 ("Unlimited Nano Banana for 7 days") is what this session was served.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint the app on #101010.** The body uses primary-950, not the slightly darker `--background`. See [home-dark-default](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
2. **Do keep chrome neutral and spend blue on the action.** Sign in and plan buttons are white. Continue with Email and the 40% off badge use `#006eff`. See [nav-signin](components/crops/nav-signin-default.png) and [price-badge](components/crops/price-badge-default.png).
3. **Do set UI in Suisse Intl.** One family carries sidebar rows, headings and the composer. Book weight is 450. See [price-h1](components/crops/price-h1-default.png).
4. **Do use a 10px radius on sidebar controls.** Sign in and nav rows share `--radius` at 10px. Plan CTAs are pills. See [nav-signin](components/crops/nav-signin-default.png) and [price-cta](components/crops/price-cta-default.png).
5. **Do keep the sidebar at 255px on desktop.** Folding it is a local toggle, not a second layout. See [sidebar](components/crops/sidebar-default.png) and [home-dark-sidebar-folded](screenshots/home-dark-sidebar-folded.png).
6. **Don't invent a light app shell.** /plugins paints a white marketing hero. The app shell, login and pricing stay dark. See [plugins-dark-default](screenshots/plugins-dark-default.png) and [home-dark-default](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
7. **Don't style the signed-in product from this package.** Assets, train, nodes, account and billing were never reached. Stop at the login card. See [login-dark-default](screenshots/login-dark-default.png).
8. **Don't follow Generate, Get Pro or Book a call.** Those controls were measured. Submitting them is a gated action. See [price-cta](components/crops/price-cta-default.png) and [ent-cta](components/crops/ent-cta-default.png).
